before.mechanism: Awaited Network Request (HTTP roundtrip before UI state mutation)
before.user_experience: Button loading spinner / lag noticeable while waiting for server response

after.mechanism: Optimistic UI Update (Synchronous React state update + background fetch + rollback on error)
after.user_experience: Instantaneous UI feedback (< 16ms / single animation frame)
after.rollback_safety: Previous state snapshot captured; fully restored upon network exception

comparison.error_resilience: 100% snapshot rollback guaranteed on API error
